title: Beeminder Pledge Increase Risk
dataSources: Habit activity (`lifeos:habit`), streaks (`lifeos:streak`), Beeminder goals (`lifeos:beeminder`), OKRs (`lifeos:okr`), planning syncs (`lifeos:ops`).
app: Personal life-OS telemetry — Habitica quest logs, Streaks app habit chains, Beeminder goal data, and personal OKR reviews — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:beeminder goal_slug=* pledge_increased=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(pledge_increased="yes",1,0))) as matched by goal_slug
| eval a_pledge_increase_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_pledge_increase_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Beeminder checkpoints that end with a pledge increase by goal.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which goal are helping or hurting Beeminder checkpoints.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a pledge increase` on `lifeos:beeminder` events and summarize the hit rate by `goal_slug`.
visualization: Table of goal with percentage of Beeminder checkpoints ending with a pledge increase.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how often a pledge increase happens for each goal so you can see where Beeminder checkpoints go smoothly or get stuck.
